description.raw: Ludovic generates a field of everblooms with a total healing amount equal to 1200% of his current ATK at his position, restoring HP for adjacent allies by up to 150% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) per second. Ludovic is unaffected while generating the everbloom field. The everbloom field will wither when its healing amount depletes but will restor 100% (ATK-based) per second and review when the healing amount is full. Active. Ludovic moves the everbloom field to a designated tile for it to release 3 healing waves, each restoring HP for all allies within 2 tiles by 110% (ATK-based). This takes effect even when the everbloom field is withered.

description.raw: Whenever a non-summoned enemy on the battlefield loses 40% (HP-based) of their HP, the everbloom field will absorb 15% (HP-based) of their max HP, up to 350% (ATK-based), as nutrients to restore its healing amount. Active. Ludovic hurls everblooms at the enemy with the highest accumulated damage dealt, making them lose HP equal to 40% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) per second over the next 4s.
